prompt_en: Create a photorealistic vertical editorial fashion photograph inside a wind-carved basalt alcove with a shallow black-stone reflecting basin. One unmistakably adult woman with balanced oval facial proportions, a softly tapered jaw, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture sits at the basin edge with both feet grounded at different depths. She holds a poised seated position, one hand bearing weight on basalt and the other lightly maintaining a terminal fold at the hip. A single length of opaque smoke-violet silk twill is the complete outfit and sole coverage mechanism. It begins at the upper back, passes securely over one shoulder and across the chest, continues around torso and pelvis, and settles across the lap with a tensioned end anchored beneath the nearer thigh. One unmistakably adult figure is the complete study subject, framed from head through torso to both grounded feet. One opaque drape wrap or integrated form is the primary visible carrier of non-explicit coverage, realized as one smoke-violet silk-twill wrap. One stable opaque coverage path remains continuous over non-explicit anatomy from upper back across chest, torso, pelvis, and lap. The carrier is visibly the complete outfit, establishing that no separate fully opaque full-body garment makes that coverage carrier visually redundant. Body contour continues plausibly around both edges of the occluding form, with readable form before and after each textile edge. Directional light and continuous body-bounded negative space model three-dimensional form around the wrap and seated adult figure. Head torso support limbs and pose remain readable as one holistic figure study, including both arms, both legs, and the basin edge. A low raking sunset beam enters from frame-right while dim blue ambient fill holds the shadow-side cloth edge, skin texture, and fabric thickness. Let the basin rim form a shallow arc behind the body while a narrow reflection separates the nearer calf from black stone. Use a 58 mm lens and a vertical 2:3 full-figure composition, with natural photographic detail and a clear hierarchy from face to continuous textile path to grounded support.
